levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Shortlist is missing one or more of the four required elements (requirements/timeline, cost/funding categories, fit notes, deadline) for at least one pathway.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Shortlist includes all four required elements for both pathways, pulled from the unit's earlier research.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Shortlist includes all four required elements for both pathways and clearly identifies the single nearest deadline across both, with what must happen before it.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The two pathways are described separately with no direct comparison between them.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The shortlist directly compares the two pathways on at least two of the four elements.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The shortlist directly compares the two pathways on all four elements and the day-1 warm-up explains why this specific pair is the most useful comparison.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Guardian review is reported as a formality with no specific question or concern named.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: A specific guardian question or concern is named along with the learner's response to it.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The learner describes a specific change made to the shortlist as a direct result of the guardian's review.

lookFors: The two pathways compared are genuinely different from each other, not two close variants of the same pathway.
Information in the shortlist traces back to the learner's own research from earlier in the unit rather than being invented fresh.
No real household financial figures appear in the shortlist, only the general categories established on day 3.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
